hot_path: Every 5s while the power panel is open, and on each open. Not a bar tick or a keypress. The only production caller of omarchy-system-stats.
why_hot: The panel timer is interval 5000 and running while opened. Each tick starts top -bn1, which sleeps 100ms twice, and the QML stores the text in systemInfo, which no file reads.

after_ms.note: The patch removes the only production caller. The command was not rewritten and was not re-timed as a faster command. Quickshell is not installed, so the patched panel was not executed.

tests.note: Covers top's locale parsing. The command is unchanged, so this stays green. No test asserts the panel spawns the command.

avoided.open_prs: First page of open omacom/omarchy PR titles on 2026-11-11 did not mention this panel. Per-file diffs were not re-fetched after API credentials failed.

dhh_acceptance: Reasonable. One deletion of an unread poll whose cost is two 100ms sleeps inside top. He might rather render the CPU line, which is a different change and should not keep top -bn1.
